title: Gisou Kareshi ni Aisarete Shimaimashita
titleNative: 偽装カレシに愛されてしまいました
synopsis: "Next time, please listen to my request." On the night of her 32nd birthday, female doctor Megumi is dumped by her boyfriend of seven years, who tells her, "I've found someone else I want to protect." He's cheating on her... and breaking up with her...! What's more, she's invited to her engagement party by the thief-like woman, Kurumi (she knows it!!). In a desperate situation, Megumi asks Akiho, a young doctor with an enlightened personality, to pretend to be her boyfriend, in order to get back at the two men. However, Akiho didn't agree to be her fake boyfriend out of goodwill, as she has another plan...!? "Surely this can't be the end," Akiho says with a serious face. What is her "request"...?! What is happiness for a woman?! A turbulent love comedy dedicated to independent women begins!! (Source : Mecha Comic, translated)

synopsis: Starting a new job at "Delivery Eats" has one BIG challenge—a scary-looking lady who’s a regular customer. She glares at you every time you deliver her food, and in this rural town, there’s only one delivery boy to handle her orders. But on his next visit, she finally speaks—and he recognizes her voice as none other than his favorite VTuber, Hanae Fuwari! Even more shocking, she offers to pay him just to chat with her?! This is the comedic tale of an introverted delivery boy and a shy but intimidating-looking woman getting a second chance at youth! (Source: Manga UP!) Note: Originally self-published on Pixiv, the manga got licensed by Square Enix on April 2024. The serialization started on June 8th, 2024 and the first compiled volume was published June 20th, 2024.

synopsis: Jiang Shu is a graduate student in the History Department. When she accidentally travels back in time to the Qi dynasty, she remembers exactly how the history went. She knows that Qi Changning is a famously tyrannical queen, regarded as a villainess in the history books. Jiang Shu was content to play along and act like an obsequious lap-dog in order to survive. title: Sono Na wa 101
synonyms: Sono Na wa One Zero One
synopsis: The sequel to "Babel II" set a few years after Yomi's defeat. This time Babel's enemies are the US military and the CIA, who are interested in using Babel's power for their own nefarious purposes after Babel had given them a sample of his own blood to use for charitable purposes. Not only will Babel be forced to fight against adversaries endowed with his own powers, but he will also not be able to count on the help of his trusted companions, imprisoned in a place where not even his brainwaves can reach them. A true ending to Babel II, completely ignoring Part 4 of the original manga. Note: Includes one-shot "Point 4".
